title: Siman 433
section: Not to Be Stubborn About Anything

segments.he: אָמַראִם לֹא נִמְצָא מְפרָשׁ בְּדִבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּפֵרוּשׁ שֶׁאָסוּר לוֹמַר גִּירָא
segments.en: (4.) Regarding his cough — he wanted to bring up phlegm during the cough, and could not. And he did not force himself greatly on this. Afterwards after a little while the phlegm came up by itself easily — and I was standing before him. He answered and said to me: "Even from this one can see that it is impossible to force oneself greatly on any matter. For at first I could not bring up the phlegm — but I was quiet and at rest and did not force myself to bring it up specifically. And afterwards..."
